title: Adjectives: words that describe nouns
examples: What is the difference between taller and tallest?
Why is it better and not gooder?

explain.say: Listen to 2 sentences. I saw a dog. I saw a huge, fluffy, golden dog. The second one tells you more. Huge, fluffy and golden are adjectives. An adjective describes a noun. Look at the size box: huge, tiny and tall.

explain.say: Some adjectives tell you a colour. Look at the colour box: red, golden and green. A red kite. A golden sunset. What colour is your bag?

explain.say: Now look at the feel or taste box: soft, spicy and sticky. A spicy curry. A sticky mango. The last box shows feelings: a brave girl, a sleepy baby. Which adjective describes you today?

explain.say: Adjectives can compare 2 things. Look at the board. Tall with er on the end makes taller. Amir is taller than his sister. A melon is bigger than a lime.
Now add est to make tallest. Use it for 3 or more things. The giraffe is the tallest animal. Some adjectives change in a different way. Good, better, best. Bad, worse, worst.

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: est means the most of all

faq.a: An adjective is a describing word that tells you more about a noun, like a huge dog, a red kite or a brave girl.

faq.q: What is the difference between taller and tallest?
faq.a: Taller compares two things: Amir is taller than Sara. Tallest compares three or more: Amir is the tallest in the family.

faq.q: Why is it better and not gooder?
faq.a: Good is irregular: good, better, best. Bad is too: bad, worse, worst. These come from very old English words.

faq.q: When do I use more instead of er?
faq.a: For most long adjectives use more and most: more beautiful, most exciting. Short words take er and est: faster, fastest.

faq.q: Where does an adjective go in a sentence?
faq.a: Usually just before the noun, as in a spicy curry, or after a verb like is, as in the curry is spicy.
asks: Does the adjective go before the noun?

facts: The giraffe is the tallest living land animal, up to about 5.5 metres.
In Spanish and French most adjectives come after the noun, as in casa blanca, white house.

quiz.say: Read the sentence on the card. Which word is an adjective?
quiz.show: Find the adjective: The sleepy cat sat on the mat.
quiz.why: sleepy describes the cat. So it is an adjective.

wrong.0: cat is a noun. It is the animal being described.
wrong.1: sat is a verb. It tells you what the cat did.

quiz.say: Read the sentence on the card. Which word fits the gap?
quiz.show: Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.
quiz.why: You compare every mountain in the world. So you need est: highest.

wrong.2: Short adjectives like high take est. So you say highest.
